sent.alphafade: In 100\% of the market-neutral books the annualized alpha against the CRSP market is lower in 2008--13 than in 1996--2001
sent.best_eras: It is not positive in all three eras in any of the nine books
sent.biggest_fix: the largest median cost to return is point-in-time deciles ($-$1.3 percentage points a year)
sent.blend_vs_equity: a Sharpe ratio of 1.09 against 1.24 for its equity sleeve (lower), and a return of 4.90\% against 5.64\% at a volatility of 4.46\% against 4.51\%
sent.blend_vs_sleeves: does not exceed the better sleeve's Sharpe ratio
sent.bv: Holding beta fixed, the calm-minus-jumpy gap shrinks to an average of $-$1 bp per dollar, while holding volatility fixed the low-minus-high-beta gap remains 120 bp
sent.bv.plain: In plain terms, the calm edge is mostly a low-beta edge: most of the apparent gain from sizing by volatility is a gain from tilting toward low-beta stocks, which calm stocks tend to be. It means the Sharpe gain of the volatility-sized books should not be attributed to volatility itself, and that a direct beta rule is the more natural next candidate.
sent.d1ff: no longer recovers: its size/book-to-market-adjusted 60-day return is $-$1.55\%
sent.d1recovery: the worst decile's market-adjusted return recovers to 0.12\% by day 60
sent.eq_dsr: clears the 0.95 bar at the counted $N$
sent.hbs: In 9 of 9 books the alpha of high-beta shorts is statistically indistinguishable from zero ($|t|<2$), and in 8 of 9 they lose real dollars in all three eras
sent.het_era: The across-era difference is not statistically detectable (Cochran $Q=8.0$ on 4 d.f., $p=0.091$, independence approximation)
sent.ivolk: rises with the exponent up to $k=3$ and does not rise further
sent.legs: the long leg earns 1.8 to 3.0 times the short leg per dollar traded (median 2.6)
sent.monotone: Decile means are strictly increasing in surprise at $+1$d; at $+5$d, $+10$d, $+20$d, $+40$d, $+60$d the tails are ordered but the middle deciles are not strictly monotone.
sent.opt_dsr: does not clear the 0.95 bar under either measure of trial dispersion
sent.opt_edge: has a probabilistic Sharpe ratio against zero of 0.739, so its edge is not statistically distinguishable from none
sent.opt_over: overstated the return by a factor of 30.4 and the Sharpe ratio by a factor of 24.2

sent.rising.mkt: rises with every step in the horizon
